Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that "Knee Deep In My Heart" was released more recently than "Go Ahead And Break My Heart." The WebSurfer results clearly stated that "Knee Deep In My Heart" was released on November 29, 2013, and "Go Ahead And Break My Heart" was released on May 9, 2016. The Planner misinterpreted the chronological order of the dates and mistakenly determined that the earlier 2013 release date was more recent than the 2016 release date. This error directly led to the incorrect final answer.
